title: Carbon Brake Wear Pin Datum and Torque Tube Attachment Rework

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: A relocated wear pin datum and a stiffened torque tube attachment for the carbon brake, introduced after operators found the pin reading full life on a stack that was in fact at its limit.

sections.reason: The wear pin as delivered reads against the pressure plate, which itself moves as the torque tube attachment relaxes. On a high-cycle aircraft the two effects cancel and the pin reads about eight per cent of stack life more than is really there. Two operators found brakes at zero remaining life during a wheel change that the pin had passed at the previous turnaround. The population at risk is the fleet operating short sectors at high landing weight, which is about a hundred and forty aircraft.
sections.description: The wear pin datum is moved from the pressure plate to a bracket on the torque tube flange, so that the reading no longer depends on the attachment. The brake regulator D3240112571209 is refitted with the pin boss added, and the pump kit D3240119570323 is retained. The torque tube attachment is stiffened with a doubled flange, using swaged collars LN606496-25 and plain washers AGS678120-8C at the eight positions. Pump 1GB, pipe 274GB and the inboard pump 584GB are refitted after the assembly is broken. The pin scale is re-marked in millimetres remaining rather than in percentage, which is what the line engineer actually measures. Work is at the main gear doors and gear bay in zones 753, 731 and 774. Detail is on drawing D32401123478.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 3.6 kg per brake, fourteen kilograms per aircraft on the main gear. No electrical load change. The reworked brake is not interchangeable with the original, and a mixed installation on one bogie is not permitted because the wear readings are not comparable. The wear check acceptance changes from a percentage to a dimension and the turnaround card is rewritten. Brake removal for wear rises briefly during transition as the true remaining life becomes visible, then falls below the pre-modification rate.
sections.embodiment_note: Production cut-in at MSN S01068. Retrofit is done at brake overhaul, offered through a modification bulletin with an inspection bulletin ahead of it to find the brakes already past their limit. Superseded in 2026 by the extended taxi duty standard.

type_data.balance_impact: Aft of the reference datum at the main gear; recorded
